images.thresholds_note: Size thresholds: thumbnail target <50 KB (warn >100, critical >200); content image <100 KB (>200, >500); hero/banner <200 KB (>300, >700). WebP/AVIF is preferred; no conversion is suggested for an image that already serves WebP/AVIF.

notes: Measured: 47 checks ran and produced 12 findings.
Checks that could not be measured (3) are never counted as "passed" and do not count toward the score.
Thresholds such as title/description length, URL length and word count are display heuristics, not rules published by search engines.
Category weights are this product's internal model; Google does not publish numeric weights for ranking.
Coverage means two different things: category coverage (measured weight in the score) and page coverage (fetched pages).
If an indexing blocker exists on the entry page the score is capped; the cap is given with the overall score (`scores.overall.gate`).
A category score is the severity-weighted share of the applicable checks in that category that passed; a check that could not be measured is not counted as passed and leaves the denominator.
Speed and weight measurements are lab values taken from this machine; they are not real-user (field) data.
Visibility signals are informational, do not count toward the score, and are not proof of indexing.
Sample: 25 pages planned, 10 fetched. Findings are expressed as ratios measured in the sample; no estimate is made for the whole site.

scope_note.intro: This score only measures the technical and on-page hygiene of your site: is it set up correctly, is anything in the way. On its own it does not tell whether the site will show up in search. Not measured:
items: Indexing status: whether Google has actually indexed the page
Rankings and the searches you appear in
Backlinks (links from other sites) and authority
Field speed data: what real users experience (the speed measurement in this report is a lab value taken from this machine)
scope_note.model_note: The score is an estimated model: the weights are this product's internal model and have not been calibrated against real rankings.
scope_note.next_step: What can be done: connect your Google account (Search Console) for indexing and search data; only read access is requested; until it is connected, the visibility signals are informational only.
